```{r prep-data}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pop_data <- clean_data() |> preproc_data()

# keep only people observed at both wave 2 (pre-baseline, for lagged in w3) and wave 6 (outcome)
eligible_pidp <- intersect(
  pop_data[wave == 2 & response == 1, pidp],
  pop_data[wave == 6 & response == 1, pidp]
)

pop_DT <- pop_data[pidp %in% eligible_pidp]

# long format variable shifting
long_data <- pop_DT[, `:=`(
  t0 = t0 - 2L,
  pcs_lagged = shift(sf12pcs_dv, type = "lag"),
  mcs_lagged = shift(sf12mcs_dv, type = "lag"),
  lagged_dnc = shift(dnc, type = "lag"),
  lagged_home_owner = shift(home_owner, type = "lag"),
  lagged_econ_benefits = shift(econ_benefits, type = "lag"),
  lagged_gor_dv_fact = shift(gor_dv_fact, type = "lag"),
  lagged_age_dv = shift(age_dv, type = "lag"),
  lagged_mastat_dv = shift(mastat_dv, type = "lag")
  )][wave %in% 3:6]

# keeping those with at least 2 observed MCS outcomes and no baseline missing
no_mh_outcomes <- long_data[,
  .(n_missing = sum(is.na(sf12mcs_dv)), base_missing = all(is.na(sf12mcs_dv_base))),
  by = pidp
][n_missing >= 2 & base_missing == TRUE, .(pidp)]

long_data <- long_data[!no_mh_outcomes, on = .(pidp)]
```

```{r build-objects}
strat_per_person <- long_data[, .(pidp, t0, econ_emp_bin)] |>
  dcast(pidp ~ t0, value.var = "econ_emp_bin") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  transmute(
    pidp,
    strategy = paste(`0`, `1`, `2`, `3`, sep = "-"),
    strategy = if_else(str_detect(strategy, "NA"), "Missing", strategy),
    strategy = str_replace_all(strategy, c("0" = "E", "1" = "U"))
  )

baseline_chars <- long_data[t0 == 0, .(pidp, sex_dv_base, hiqual_dv_base, age_dv,
                                        sf12mcs_dv, sf12pcs_dv,
                                        race_base, home_owner, mastat_dv,
                                        dnc_fact, log_income, econ_benefits, econ_dist)] |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rename(mcs_w3 = sf12mcs_dv, pcs_w3 = sf12pcs_dv) |>
  mutate(
    female       = sex_dv_base == "Female",
    hiqual_i     = as.integer(hiqual_dv_base),
    edu_degree   = hiqual_i == 1L,
    edu_higher   = hiqual_i == 2L,
    edu_alevel   = hiqual_i == 3L,
    edu_gcse     = hiqual_i == 4L,
    edu_other    = hiqual_i == 5L,
    edu_none     = hiqual_i == 9L,
    nonwhite     = race_base == "Non-white",
    owner        = home_owner == "Owner",
    partnered    = mastat_dv %in% 1:2,
    mastat_cat   = factor(
      case_when(
        mastat_dv == 1L ~ "Married",
        mastat_dv == 2L ~ "Living as couple",
        mastat_dv == 3L ~ "Widowed",
        mastat_dv == 4L ~ "Divorced",
        mastat_dv == 5L ~ "Separated",
        mastat_dv == 6L ~ "Never married"
      ),
      levels = c("Married", "Living as couple", "Widowed",
                 "Divorced", "Separated", "Never married")
    ),
    econ_dist_cat = factor(
      case_when(
        econ_dist == 1L ~ "Finding it very difficult",
        econ_dist == 2L ~ "Finding it quite difficult",
        econ_dist == 3L ~ "Just about getting by",
        econ_dist == 4L ~ "Doing alright",
        econ_dist == 5L ~ "Living comfortably"
      ),
      levels = c("Finding it very difficult", "Finding it quite difficult",
                 "Just about getting by", "Doing alright", "Living comfortably")
    ),
    benefits     = econ_benefits == 1L
  )

outcome_chars <- long_data[t0 == 3, .(pidp, sf12mcs_dv, sf12pcs_dv)] |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rename(mcs_w6 = sf12mcs_dv, pcs_w6 = sf12pcs_dv)
```

# Table 1 — overall sample

```{r tab1-long}
#| output: true
#| label: tbl-table1
#| tbl-cap: "Table 1. Baseline characteristics of the analytic sample. Education and sex from wave 1; age at wave 3 (start of intervention period). Employment trajectory coded as wave 3–wave 6 (0 = employed, 1 = not employed)."

indent <- "    "
N      <- nrow(strat_per_person)

tab1_data <- strat_per_person |>
  left_join(baseline_chars, by = "pidp") |>
  left_join(outcome_chars,  by = "pidp")

fmt_pct <- function(x, total = N) paste0(format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE), " (", round(x / total * 100, 1), "%)")

na_row <- function(var) {
  n_na <- sum(is.na(var))
  if (n_na == 0) return(NULL)
  tibble(Characteristic = paste0(indent, "Missing"), Summary = fmt_pct(n_na))
}

rows <- bind_rows(
  # ── Sex ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  tibble(Characteristic = "**Sex**", Summary = ""),
  tab1_data |>
    count(sex_dv_base) |>
    filter(!is.na(sex_dv_base)) |>
    arrange(sex_dv_base) |>
    transmute(
      Characteristic = paste0(indent, sex_dv_base),
      Summary        = fmt_pct(n)
    ),
  na_row(tab1_data$sex_dv_base),

  # ── Education ────────────────────────────────────────
  tibble(Characteristic = "**Education**", Summary = ""),
  tab1_data |>
    mutate(edu_cat = factor(
      case_when(
        hiqual_i == 1L ~ "Degree",
        hiqual_i == 2L ~ "Other higher degree",
        hiqual_i == 3L ~ "A-level etc",
        hiqual_i == 4L ~ "GCSE etc",
        hiqual_i == 5L ~ "Other qualification",
        hiqual_i == 9L ~ "No qualification"
      ),
      levels = c("Degree", "Other higher degree", "A-level etc",
                 "GCSE etc", "Other qualification", "No qualification")
    )) |>
    count(edu_cat, .drop = FALSE) |>
    filter(!is.na(edu_cat)) |>
    transmute(
      Characteristic = paste0(indent, edu_cat),
      Summary        = fmt_pct(n)
    ),
  na_row(tab1_data$hiqual_i),

  # ── Age ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  tab1_data |>
    summarise(
      Characteristic = "**Age, mean (SD)**",
      Summary        = paste0(
        round(mean(age_dv, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
        " (", round(sd(age_dv, na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")"
      )
    ),
  na_row(tab1_data$age_dv),

  # ── Ethnicity ─────────────────────────────────────────
  tibble(Characteristic = "**Ethnicity**", Summary = ""),
  tab1_data |>
    count(race_base) |>
    filter(!is.na(race_base)) |>
    arrange(race_base) |>
    transmute(
      Characteristic = paste0(indent, race_base),
      Summary        = fmt_pct(n)
    ),
  na_row(tab1_data$race_base),

  # ── Marital status ────────────────────────────────────
  tibble(Characteristic = "**Marital status**", Summary = ""),
  tab1_data |>
    count(mastat_cat, .drop = FALSE) |>
    filter(!is.na(mastat_cat)) |>
    transmute(
      Characteristic = paste0(indent, mastat_cat),
      Summary        = fmt_pct(n)
    ),
  na_row(tab1_data$mastat_cat),

  # ── Home ownership ────────────────────────────────────
  tibble(Characteristic = "**Home ownership**", Summary = ""),
  tab1_data |>
    count(home_owner) |>
    filter(!is.na(home_owner)) |>
    arrange(home_owner) |>
    transmute(
      Characteristic = paste0(indent, home_owner),
      Summary        = fmt_pct(n)
    ),
  na_row(tab1_data$home_owner),

  # ── Dependent children ────────────────────────────────
  tibble(Characteristic = "**Dependent children**", Summary = ""),
  tab1_data |>
    count(dnc_fact, .drop = FALSE) |>
    filter(!is.na(dnc_fact)) |>
    transmute(
      Characteristic = paste0(indent, dnc_fact),
      Summary        = fmt_pct(n)
    ),
  na_row(tab1_data$dnc_fact),

  # ── Log income ────────────────────────────────────────
  tab1_data |>
    summarise(
      Characteristic = "**Log income, mean (SD)**",
      Summary        = paste0(round(mean(log_income, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
                              " (", round(sd(log_income, na.rm = TRUE), 2), ")")
    ),
  na_row(tab1_data$log_income),

  # ── Economic benefits ─────────────────────────────────
  tibble(Characteristic = "**Receiving benefits**", Summary = ""),
  tab1_data |>
    count(benefits) |>
    filter(!is.na(benefits)) |>
    transmute(
      Characteristic = paste0(indent, if_else(benefits, "Yes", "No")),
      Summary        = fmt_pct(n)
    ),
  na_row(tab1_data$econ_benefits),

  # ── Economic distress ─────────────────────────────────
  tibble(Characteristic = "**Financial situation**", Summary = ""),
  tab1_data |>
    count(econ_dist_cat, .drop = FALSE) |>
    filter(!is.na(econ_dist_cat)) |>
    transmute(
      Characteristic = paste0(indent, econ_dist_cat),
      Summary        = fmt_pct(n)
    ),
  na_row(tab1_data$econ_dist_cat),

  # ── MCS ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  tibble(Characteristic = "**MCS, mean (SD)**", Summary = ""),
  tab1_data |>
    summarise(
      Characteristic = paste0(indent, "Wave 3"),
      Summary        = paste0(round(mean(mcs_w3, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
                              " (", round(sd(mcs_w3, na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")")
    ),
  tab1_data |>
    summarise(
      Characteristic = paste0(indent, "Wave 6"),
      Summary        = paste0(round(mean(mcs_w6, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
                              " (", round(sd(mcs_w6, na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")")
    ),
  na_row(tab1_data$mcs_w3),

  # ── PCS ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  tibble(Characteristic = "**PCS, mean (SD)**", Summary = ""),
  tab1_data |>
    summarise(
      Characteristic = paste0(indent, "Wave 3"),
      Summary        = paste0(round(mean(pcs_w3, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
                              " (", round(sd(pcs_w3, na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")")
    ),
  tab1_data |>
    summarise(
      Characteristic = paste0(indent, "Wave 6"),
      Summary        = paste0(round(mean(pcs_w6, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
                              " (", round(sd(pcs_w6, na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")")
    ),
  na_row(tab1_data$pcs_w3),

  # ── Employment trajectory ────────────────────────────
  tibble(Characteristic = "**Employment trajectory**", Summary = ""),
  tab1_data |>
    count(strategy) |>
    arrange(strategy == "Missing", strategy) |>
    transmute(
      Characteristic = paste0(indent, strategy),
      Summary        = fmt_pct(n)
    ),

  # ── Footnotes ─────────────────────────────────────────
  tibble(Characteristic = "ᵃ Percentages correspond to the analytic sample at wave 3 (baseline).", Summary = ""),
  tibble(Characteristic = "ᵇ Summary statistics are presented as n (%) unless otherwise specified.", Summary = "")
)

rows |>
  knitr::kable(escape = FALSE, col.names = c("Characteristic", "n (%) or mean (SD)"))
```

```{r export-word}
footnote_rows <- rows |>
  filter(str_detect(Characteristic, "^[ᵃᵇ]"))

rows_clean <- rows |>
  filter(!str_detect(Characteristic, "^[ᵃᵇ]")) |>
  mutate(
    is_header = str_detect(Characteristic, "^\\*\\*"),
    Characteristic = str_remove_all(Characteristic, "\\*\\*")
  )

flextable(rows_clean |> select(Characteristic, Summary)) |>
  set_header_labels(Characteristic = "Characteristic", Summary = "n (%) or mean (SD)") |>
  bold(i = which(rows_clean$is_header), j = 1) |>
  add_footer_lines(footnote_rows$Characteristic) |>
  autofit() |>
  save_as_docx(path = here::here("manuscript", "table1.docx"))
```

# Supplementary Table 1  - Complete and imputed samples

```{r tab1-supp}
#| output: true
#| label: tbl-table1-supp
#| tbl-cap: "Supplementary Table 1. Baseline characteristics of the complete case and imputed samples."
wide_mids_mcs <- readRDS(here::here("output", "wide_mids_mcs_4w.rds"))
wide_mids_pcs <- readRDS(here::here("output", "wide_mids_pcs_4w.rds"))

# ── Extract data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
orig     <- mice::complete(wide_mids_mcs, 0)          # original data (with NAs)
orig_pcs <- mice::complete(wide_mids_pcs, 0)
imp_mcs  <- mice::complete(wide_mids_mcs, "long", include = FALSE)  # M datasets stacked
imp_pcs  <- mice::complete(wide_mids_pcs, "long", include = FALSE)
M        <- wide_mids_mcs$m
N_s      <- nrow(orig)

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
obs_pct <- function(x, lv) {
  n <- sum(x == lv, na.rm = TRUE)
  paste0(format(n, big.mark = ","), " (", round(n / N_s * 100, 1), "%)")
}
obs_cont <- function(x) {
  paste0(round(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 1), " (", round(sd(x, na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")")
}
obs_na_row <- function(x) {
  n <- sum(is.na(x)); if (n == 0) return(NULL)
  tibble(Characteristic = paste0(indent, "Missing"),
         Observed = paste0(format(n, big.mark = ","), " (", round(n / N_s * 100, 1), "%)"),
         Imputed  = "—")
}

# average per-imputation proportions (= mean over M×N rows)
imp_pct <- function(x, lv) {
  p <- mean(x == lv, na.rm = TRUE)
  paste0(format(round(p * N_s), big.mark = ","), " (", round(p * 100, 1), "%)")
}
# pool means and average within-imputation SDs across M
imp_cont <- function(x, g) {
  st <- tibble(x = x, g = g) |>
    group_by(g) |>
    summarise(m = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), s = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  paste0(round(mean(st$m), 1), " (", round(mean(st$s), 1), ")")
}

hdr     <- function(lbl) tibble(Characteristic = lbl, Observed = "", Imputed = "")
cat_row <- function(o, i, lv, lb = as.character(lv)) {
  tibble(Characteristic = paste0(indent, lb),
         Observed = obs_pct(o, lv), Imputed = imp_pct(i, lv))
}

# ── Recoding helpers (wide data uses numeric codes) ───────────────────────────
to_edu <- function(x) factor(case_when(
  x == 1L ~ "Degree",            x == 2L ~ "Other higher degree",
  x == 3L ~ "A-level etc",       x == 4L ~ "GCSE etc",
  x == 5L ~ "Other qualification", x == 9L ~ "No qualification"
), levels = c("Degree", "Other higher degree", "A-level etc",
              "GCSE etc", "Other qualification", "No qualification"))

to_mastat <- function(x) factor(case_when(
  x == 1L ~ "Married",          x == 2L ~ "Living as couple",
  x == 3L ~ "Widowed",          x == 4L ~ "Divorced",
  x == 5L ~ "Separated",        x == 6L ~ "Never married"
), levels = c("Married", "Living as couple", "Widowed",
              "Divorced", "Separated", "Never married"))

to_dnc <- function(x) factor(case_when(
  x == 0L ~ "zero", x == 1L ~ "one", !is.na(x) & x > 1L ~ "2+"
), levels = c("zero", "one", "2+"))

to_dist <- function(x) factor(case_when(
  x == 1L ~ "Finding it very difficult", x == 2L ~ "Finding it quite difficult",
  x == 3L ~ "Just about getting by",     x == 4L ~ "Doing alright",
  x == 5L ~ "Living comfortably"
), levels = c("Finding it very difficult", "Finding it quite difficult",
              "Just about getting by", "Doing alright", "Living comfortably"))

# precomputed recoded vectors
obs_edu    <- to_edu(as.integer(orig$hiqual_dv_base))
obs_mastat <- to_mastat(orig$lagged_mastat_dv_1)
obs_dnc    <- to_dnc(orig$lagged_dnc_1)
obs_dist   <- to_dist(orig$econ_dist_0)

imp_edu    <- to_edu(as.integer(imp_mcs$hiqual_dv_base))
imp_mastat <- to_mastat(imp_mcs$lagged_mastat_dv_1)
imp_dnc    <- to_dnc(imp_mcs$lagged_dnc_1)
imp_dist   <- to_dist(imp_mcs$econ_dist_0)

edu_lv    <- levels(obs_edu)
mastat_lv <- levels(obs_mastat)
dnc_lv    <- levels(obs_dnc)
dist_lv   <- levels(obs_dist)

# ── Build rows ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
supp_rows <- bind_rows(

  # Sex ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  hdr("**Sex**"),
  cat_row(orig$sex_dv_base, imp_mcs$sex_dv_base, "Female"),
  cat_row(orig$sex_dv_base, imp_mcs$sex_dv_base, "Male"),
  obs_na_row(orig$sex_dv_base),

  # Education ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  hdr("**Education**"),
  map_dfr(edu_lv, \(lv) cat_row(obs_edu, imp_edu, lv)),
  obs_na_row(obs_edu),

  # Age ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # lagged_age_dv_1 = age at t0=0 (wave 3), since lagged[t=1] = current[t=0]
  tibble(Characteristic = "**Age, mean (SD)**",
         Observed = obs_cont(orig$lagged_age_dv_1),
         Imputed  = imp_cont(imp_mcs$lagged_age_dv_1, imp_mcs$.imp)),
  obs_na_row(orig$lagged_age_dv_1),

  # Ethnicity ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  hdr("**Ethnicity**"),
  cat_row(orig$race_base, imp_mcs$race_base, "Non-white"),
  cat_row(orig$race_base, imp_mcs$race_base, "White"),
  obs_na_row(orig$race_base),

  # Marital status ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  hdr("**Marital status**"),
  map_dfr(mastat_lv, \(lv) cat_row(obs_mastat, imp_mastat, lv)),
  obs_na_row(obs_mastat),

  # Home ownership ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  hdr("**Home ownership**"),
  cat_row(orig$lagged_home_owner_1, imp_mcs$lagged_home_owner_1, "Owner"),
  cat_row(orig$lagged_home_owner_1, imp_mcs$lagged_home_owner_1, "Renter"),
  obs_na_row(orig$lagged_home_owner_1),

  # Dependent children ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  hdr("**Dependent children**"),
  map_dfr(dnc_lv, \(lv) cat_row(obs_dnc, imp_dnc, lv)),
  obs_na_row(obs_dnc),

  # Log income ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tibble(Characteristic = "**Log income, mean (SD)**",
         Observed = obs_cont(orig$log_income_0),
         Imputed  = imp_cont(imp_mcs$log_income_0, imp_mcs$.imp)),
  obs_na_row(orig$log_income_0),

  # Receiving benefits ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  hdr("**Receiving benefits**"),
  cat_row(orig$lagged_econ_benefits_1, imp_mcs$lagged_econ_benefits_1, 1L, "Yes"),
  cat_row(orig$lagged_econ_benefits_1, imp_mcs$lagged_econ_benefits_1, 0L, "No"),
  obs_na_row(orig$lagged_econ_benefits_1),

  # Financial situation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  hdr("**Financial situation**"),
  map_dfr(dist_lv, \(lv) cat_row(obs_dist, imp_dist, lv)),
  obs_na_row(obs_dist),

  # MCS — from MCS mids ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  hdr("**MCS, mean (SD)**"),
  tibble(Characteristic = paste0(indent, "Wave 3"),
         Observed = obs_cont(orig$sf12mcs_dv_0),
         Imputed  = imp_cont(imp_mcs$sf12mcs_dv_0, imp_mcs$.imp)),
  tibble(Characteristic = paste0(indent, "Wave 6"),
         Observed = obs_cont(orig$sf12mcs_dv_3),
         Imputed  = imp_cont(imp_mcs$sf12mcs_dv_3, imp_mcs$.imp)),
  obs_na_row(orig$sf12mcs_dv_0),

  # PCS — from PCS mids ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  hdr("**PCS, mean (SD)**"),
  tibble(Characteristic = paste0(indent, "Wave 3"),
         Observed = obs_cont(orig_pcs$sf12pcs_dv_0),
         Imputed  = imp_cont(imp_pcs$sf12pcs_dv_0, imp_pcs$.imp)),
  tibble(Characteristic = paste0(indent, "Wave 6"),
         Observed = obs_cont(orig_pcs$sf12pcs_dv_3),
         Imputed  = imp_cont(imp_pcs$sf12pcs_dv_3, imp_pcs$.imp)),
  obs_na_row(orig_pcs$sf12pcs_dv_0),

  # Employment trajectory ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  hdr("**Employment trajectory**"),
  {
    make_strat <- function(df) transmute(df,
      strategy = paste(as.character(econ_emp_bin_0), as.character(econ_emp_bin_1),
                       as.character(econ_emp_bin_2), as.character(econ_emp_bin_3), sep = "-"),
      strategy = str_replace_all(strategy, c("0" = "E", "1" = "U")),
      strategy = if_else(str_detect(strategy, "NA"), "Missing", strategy)
    )

    obs_strat <- make_strat(orig) |> count(strategy) |>
      arrange(strategy == "Missing", strategy)

    imp_strat <- make_strat(imp_mcs) |>
      mutate(.imp = imp_mcs$.imp) |>
      group_by(.imp, strategy) |> summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
      mutate(prop = n / N_s) |>
      group_by(strategy) |> summarise(prop = mean(prop), .groups = "drop") |>
      arrange(strategy)

    all_strats <- union(obs_strat$strategy, imp_strat$strategy) |>
      (\(x) x[order(x == "Missing", x)])()

    map_dfr(all_strats, function(s) {
      obs_n <- obs_strat$n[obs_strat$strategy == s]
      obs_n <- if (length(obs_n) == 0) 0L else obs_n
      imp_p <- imp_strat$prop[imp_strat$strategy == s]
      imp_p <- if (length(imp_p) == 0) 0 else imp_p
      tibble(
        Characteristic = paste0(indent, s),
        Observed = paste0(format(obs_n, big.mark = ","), " (", round(obs_n / N_s * 100, 1), "%)"),
        Imputed  = paste0(format(round(imp_p * N_s), big.mark = ","), " (", round(imp_p * 100, 1), "%)")
      )
    })
  },

  # Footnote ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tibble(
    Characteristic = paste0("ᵃ n (%) unless otherwise specified. ",
                            "Imputed statistics pooled across M = ", M, " imputations. "),
    Observed = "", Imputed = ""
  )
)

N_fmt <- format(N_s, big.mark = ",")

supp_rows |>
  knitr::kable(
    escape = FALSE,
    col.names = c(
      "Characteristic",
      paste0("Observed (n = ", N_fmt, ")"),
      paste0("Imputed (n = ", N_fmt, ", M = ", M, ")")
    )
  )
```

```{r export-supp-word}
supp_fn <- supp_rows |> filter(str_detect(Characteristic, "^ᵃ"))

supp_clean <- supp_rows |>
  filter(!str_detect(Characteristic, "^ᵃ")) |>
  mutate(
    is_header    = str_detect(Characteristic, "^\\*\\*"),
    Characteristic = str_remove_all(Characteristic, "\\*\\*")
  )

N_fmt <- format(N_s, big.mark = ",")

flextable(supp_clean |> select(Characteristic, Observed, Imputed)) |>
  set_header_labels(
    Characteristic = "Characteristic",
    Observed = paste0("Observed (n = ", N_fmt, ")"),
    Imputed  = paste0("Imputed (n = ", N_fmt, ", M = ", M, ")")
  ) |>
  bold(i = which(supp_clean$is_header), j = 1) |>
  add_footer_lines(supp_fn$Characteristic) |>
  autofit() |>
  save_as_docx(path = here::here("manuscript", "table1_supp.docx"))
```
